breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: Below: single column, inline excerpts, no sticky terminal, stacked install field.

components.name: Primary Call to Action
components.description: Filled bone pill that sends people to the GitHub repo; one per page, in the close.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 16px 24px; border-radius: 999px; background: #ece8e1; color: #000; font-family: 'Lexend', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: gap 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { gap: 18px; background: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.76 0.11 250); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Pill Link
components.description: Top-bar GitHub link: translucent black pill with a hairline, over the moai.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid #242427; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55); color: #ece8e1; font-family: 'Lexend', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #ece8e1; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.76 0.11 250); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Install Command Field
components.description: Copyable install command: panel row with red prompt and an attached copy button.
components.css: .ds-install { display: flex; align-items: stretch; max-width: 760px; background: #0a0a0b; border: 1px solid #242427; border-radius: 8px; color: #ece8e1; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-install code { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 16px 18px; font: inherit; } .ds-install code span { white-space: nowrap; } .ds-prompt { color: oklch(0.68 0.19 28); user-select: none; } .ds-install-copy { flex: none; min-width: 7.5em; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-left: 1px solid #242427; border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-install-copy:hover { background: #17171a; } .ds-install-copy:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.76 0.11 250); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Top Bar
components.description: The only navigation: wordmark label left, ghost GitHub pill right.

components.css: .ds-term { max-width: 640px; background: #0a0a0b; border: 1px solid #242427; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.6; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; box-shadow: 0 24px 60px -20px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.9); } .ds-term-bar { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 10px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #242427; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #7b7980; } .ds-term-screen { margin: 0; padding: 16px 18px 24px; font: inherit; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #a3a1a8; } .ds-line { display: inline-block; padding-left: 4ch; text-indent: -4ch; } .ds-cmd { color: #ece8e1; } .ds-prompt { color: oklch(0.68 0.19 28); user-select: none; } .ds-key { color: oklch(0.76 0.11 250); } .ds-warn { color: oklch(0.68 0.19 28); } .ds-caret { display: inline-block; width: 0.6em; height: 1.15em; vertical-align: text-bottom; background: #ece8e1; animation: ds-caret 1.1s steps(1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-caret { 50% { opacity: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-caret { animation: none; } }

components.name: Margin Note
components.description: One story step: Atkinson title plus one ash Lexend sentence; dims when not active.
components.html:
A name should mean something.

Each agent is a file in your repo that pins its harness, model, and instructions. Review changes to it like code.

Every task gets its own worktree.

A fresh branch from HEAD, with your agent config carried in. Your working files stay put. Run it in cmux, or headless in the background.
components.css: .ds-notes { background: #000; padding: 24px; } .ds-note { max-width: 36ch; padding: 24px 0; opacity: 0.35; transition: opacity 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-note.is-active, .ds-note:hover { opacity: 1; } .ds-note h2 { margin: 0 0 16px; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 2.8vw, 2.5rem); line-height: 1.12; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #ece8e1; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-note p { margin: 0; font-family: 'Lexend', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1.6; color: #a3a1a8; text-wrap: pretty; }

components.name: Glitch Wordmark
components.description: The ahu hero mark with an intermittent RGB CRT tear; used once.
components.html:
ahu

Cross harness orchestration for harness and model pinned agents.
components.css: .ds-hero { background: #000; padding: 48px 24px; text-align: center; color: #ece8e1; } .ds-mark { position: relative; display: inline-block; margin: 0; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(4.5rem, 14vw, 6rem); line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-indent: 0.12em; text-shadow: 0 2px 32px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.9); } .ds-mark::before, .ds-mark::after { content: attr(data-text); position: absolute; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; text-indent: inherit; opacity: 0.7; z-index: -1; } .ds-mark::before { color: oklch(0.55 0.2 25); animation: ds-tear 4s infinite linear; } .ds-mark::after { color: oklch(0.65 0.15 250); animation: ds-tear-alt 4s infinite linear; } @keyframes ds-tear { 0%, 100% { clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0); transform: translateX(0); } 5% { clip-path: inset(40% 0 30% 0); transform: translateX(-6px); } 10% { clip-path: inset(10% 0 60% 0); transform: translateX(4px); } 15% { clip-path: inset(70% 0 5% 0); transform: translateX(-3px); } 20% { clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0); transform: translateX(0); } } @keyframes ds-tear-alt { 0%, 100% { clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0); transform: translateX(0); } 5% { clip-path: inset(25% 0 50% 0); transform: translateX(5px); } 10% { clip-path: inset(55% 0 20% 0); transform: translateX(-7px); } 15% { clip-path: inset(5% 0 75% 0); transform: translateX(3px); } 20% { clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0); transform: translateX(0); } } .ds-hero-line { margin: 20px 0 0; font-family: 'Lexend', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2.2vw, 1.35rem); text-wrap: balance; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-mark::before, .ds-mark::after { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The page is one terminal session held up in front of a stone head made of light. Black is the ground, not a theme; everything that speaks is either bone-white prose or monospace output that ahu really printed. The particle moai owns the first viewport at full brightness, then recedes to about 15% as the session scrolls over it, so the transcript never competes with the particles.

Density is deliberately low. Each idea gets a whole viewport of scroll: a short Atkinson Hyperlegible heading, one Lexend sentence, and the command that proves it. On wide screens a single sticky terminal types each command as its margin note reaches the middle of the viewport; on narrow screens each note carries its own excerpt inline. There are no cards, no feature grids, and no decorative illustration. The only colour is signal: red for the prompt and warnings, blue for agent handles.

The CRT tear on the `ahu` wordmark is the one place the page glitches. It stays intermittent (a 4s cycle that bursts through its first 20% and holds closed) so it reads as signal loss, not noise.
keyCharacteristics: Pure black ground with a fixed particle moai backdrop that dims on scroll.
Bone-white Atkinson Hyperlegible headings, Lexend prose, Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono terminal.
Two signal colours only, each with a fixed meaning.
Hairline-bordered dark panels for anything that is terminal output; nothing else is boxed.
Pill-shaped links; one filled bone pill as the single call to action.
Motion is scroll-driven and slow-settling on one expo-out curve, and every animation has a reduced-motion off switch.

rules.name: The Two Signals Rule
rules.body: Red means prompt or warning; blue means an agent's name or keyboard focus. Neither is ever used as decoration, fill, or a section tint.

rules.name: The Bone Not White Rule
rules.body: Text is bone. Pure white appears only as the hover brightening of the bone pill and in selected text.

rules.name: The Real Output Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for text ahu actually prints or a command a person actually types. Never set prose, headings, or labels in mono to look technical.

rules.name: The Unbroken Argument Rule
rules.body: Terminal lines wrap only between arguments; a path, URL or flag never splits mid-token. Wrapped lines hang-indent 4ch under the prompt.

rules.name: The One Idea Per Viewport Rule
rules.body: On wide screens each step of the story gets a full viewport of scroll and a single heading plus one sentence. Add a step, not a paragraph.

rules.name: The Light Comes From Behind Rule
rules.body: The only light source is the particle moai. Surfaces never glow, and shadows are black, used only to hold text or the terminal off the particles.

dos: Do keep the ground pure black (#000000) and let the particle moai be the only source of light.
Do put anything that looks like terminal output in the terminal panel, and make it real, captured ahu output.
Do reserve red for the prompt and warnings and blue for agent handles and focus.
Do give every animation a `prefers-reduced-motion` off switch, as the cue, caret, line-in, tear and smooth scroll already have.
Do use the one expo-out curve (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) for state and scroll transitions.
Do keep dim (#7b7980) as the floor for any text that must be read.
donts: Don't add cards, feature grids, or boxed marketing sections; the only bordered surfaces are the terminal and the install field.
Don't use icons beyond the authored GitHub mark and arrow, and never emoji as icons.
Don't set prose or headings in monospace, or invent terminal output.
Don't glitch anything but the wordmark, and don't make the tear continuous.
Don't add a second filled call to action; the bone pill is the only one.
Don't let any element in the hero swallow pointer events except its links; the moai's drag-to-glitch listens on the whole document.
